proof_body:
by
  intro f g a b hc hd hp
  exact
    by
      apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Icc a b) hc
      intro x hx
      have hx' : x ∈ Set.Ioo a b := by simpa only [interior_Icc] using hx
      rw [(hd x hx').deriv]
      exact hp x hx'
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (g x) x) (hp : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, 0 < g x), StrictMonoOn f (Set.Icc a b)
